Matches must begin at alphanumeric tokens, i.e., 'util.Sorted' matches 'java.util.SortedSet' but not 'myutil.SortedArray'. The filter matches if all filter terms match. All non-alphanumeric characters are ignored for matching. Filtering is assumed to be prefix-search and order-independent unless phrases are surrounded by "". Any terms contained in quotes are searched using exact-match (given filter term "foo", we will not return "foobar"), and must appear in the order given exactly. To get order-dependence but prefix-search, use a * within the quotes ("abc foo*" will match "abc foobar", but not "foo abc" "abcd foobar", or "abc xyz foobar").
